53: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("MaxUserAttackLoseHalfOfTotalHP",
54:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
55:     next true if user.hp <= [user.totalhp / 2, 1].max
56:     next !user.battler.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(:ATTACK, user.battler, move.move)
57:   }
58: )
59: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("MaxUserAttackLoseHalfOfTotalHP",
60:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
61:     score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_raise(score, user, move.move.statUp)
62:     # Don't prefer the lower the user's HP is
63:     if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
64:       score -= 60 * (1 - (user.hp.to_f / user.totalhp))   # -0 to -30
65:     end
66:     next score
67:   }

193:                                             "RaiseUserSpeed2LowerUserWeight")
194: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("RaiseUserSpeed2LowerUserWeight",
195:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
196:     score = ai.get_score_for_target_stat_raise(score, user, move.move.statUp)
197:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
198:       current_weight = user.battler.pbWeight
199:       if current_weight > 1
200:         score -= 5 if user.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserHeavierThanTarget")
201:         ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
202:           score -= 5 if b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserHeavierThanTarget")
203:           score += 5 if b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithTargetWeight")
204:           # User will become susceptible to Sky Drop
205:           if b.has_move_with_function?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct") &&
206:              Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
207:             score -= 10 if current_weight >= 2000 && current_weight < 3000
208:           end
209:         end
210:       end
211:     end
212:     next score
213:   }
214: )

272:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && !user.effects[PBEffects::Minimize]
273:       ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
274:         # Moves that do double damage and (in Gen 6+) have perfect accuracy
275:         if b.check_for_move { |m| m.tramplesMinimize? }
276:           score -= (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? 15 : 10

279:     end

295: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveFailureCheck.add("RaiseUserCriticalHitRate2",
296:   proc { |move, user, ai, battle|
297:     next user.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy] >= 2
298:   }

300: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("RaiseUserCriticalHitRate2",
301:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
302:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !user.check_for_move { |m| m.damagingMove? }
303:     score += 15
304:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill?
305:       # Other effects that raise the critical hit rate
306:       if user.item_active?
307:         if [:RAZORCLAW, :SCOPELENS].include?(user.item_id) ||
308:            (user.item_id == :LUCKYPUNCH && user.battler.isSpecies?(:CHANSEY)) ||
309:            ([:LEEK, :STICK].include?(user.item_id) &&
310:            (user.battler.isSpecies?(:FARFETCHD) || user.battler.isSpecies?(:SIRFETCHD)))
311:           score += 10
312:         end
313:       end
314:       # Critical hits do more damage
315:       score += 10 if user.has_active_ability?(:SNIPER)
316:     end
317:     next score
318:   }
319: )
